archive.label: EA Security 2.0
archive.text: ET Docket No. 21-232 concerns the Commission’s proceeding on protecting against national security threats to the communications supply chain through its Equipment Authorization Program.

archive.label: EA Security 2.0
archive.text: The Commission initiated the ET Docket No. 21-232 proceeding in June 2021 through its Equipment Authorization Security Notice of Proposed Rulemaking.

archive.label: EA Security 2.0
archive.text: The proceeding involves revising the Commission’s equipment authorization program as part of efforts to protect equipment supply chains and identify and eliminate potential security vulnerabilities in communications networks and supply chains.

archive.label: record
archive.text: The Secure Equipment Act required the Commission to adopt rules in ET Docket No. 21-232 by November 11, 2022, clarifying that it would no longer review or approve applications for authorization of equipment on the Covered List.
